scripts.build: npm run check:server-boundary && npm run check:creator-radar-infrastructure && npm run check:training-cache-policy && npm run build:functions && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:ios: npm run check:server-boundary && npm run check:creator-radar-infrastructure && tsc -b && vite build --mode ios-development --outDir dist-ios --emptyOutDir && node scripts/select-ios-firebase-config.mjs --environment development
scripts.build:ios:beta: npm run check:server-boundary && npm run check:creator-radar-infrastructure && tsc -b && vite build --mode ios-beta --outDir dist-ios --emptyOutDir && node scripts/select-ios-firebase-config.mjs --environment beta
scripts.check:ios: npm run build:ios && npm run sync:ios && node scripts/check-ios-boundary.mjs
scripts.check:ios:beta: npm run build:ios:beta && npm run sync:ios && node scripts/check-ios-boundary.mjs --environment beta
scripts.test:firestore: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-marathoner --only firestore "vitest run --config vitest.firestore.config.ts"
scripts.test:material-commands: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-marathoner --only auth,functions,firestore "vitest run --config vitest.material-commands.config.ts"
